d:
Gujrat ki mashhur paranprik mithaee mohanthal. (Mohanthal Barfi). besan, ghi aur mithas se bharpur yah svadisht mithaee tyoharon aur khas avasron ke lie bahut pasand ki jati hai.
Is vidiyo men dekhiye Gujarati Mohanthal Recipe banane ka aasan tarika, jisse aap ghar par svadisht aur parphekt mohanthal barphi bana sakte hain.agar aapko Traditional Gujarati Sweets, Halwai Style Mithai aur Besan Barfi pasand hain, to yah resipi jarur traee karen.
Malaee mohanthal ke liye aavashyak samagri
Malai Mohanthal Ingredients
Besan - Gram Flour - 2 Cup (250 grams)
Malaee - Malai - 1 cup
Ghi - Ghee - 1/2 cup
